grader.scenario: Mobile 40GB data allowance exhausted five days into billing cycle due to 4K cloud sync
grader.notes: Exemplary demonstration of acknowledgment-then-refusal where the agent validated customer stress, firmly upheld billing terms regarding verified data usage, and offered a discounted commercial compromise with practical prevention guidance.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Elijah warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent acknowledged customer distress while politely refusing free credit at [03:45]: 'I completely understand how stressful it is... However, because our cellular network logs confirm... our billing terms do not permit issuing a free discretionary data booster; what I can do right now is activate our emergency ten-gigabyte bolt-on at a half-price concession...'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the 40GB allowance exhaustion and landing page redirect accurately at [01:30].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed mobile number accurately without asking for previously supplied information.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent identified root cause in Google Drive sync, provisioned bolt-on, and guided customer to lock app to Wi-Fi.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, empathetic, and constructive tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked effective diagnostic questions regarding device redirect prompts and app behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer toggled aeroplane mode, verified 5G restored, confirmed email received, and locked Google Drive to Wi-Fi.
